usage: 倉鼠 is used to refer to a small pet rodent known for running on wheels and storing food in its cheeks.
When speaking about pets, 倉鼠 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
倉鼠 can be modified by adjectives to describe color or behavior, e.g., '仔倉鼠' (small hamster).
It is common to use 倉鼠 when giving advice or talking about taking care of this pet.
倉鼠 does not change form to indicate singular or plural, the context or measure words clarify this.
